newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian president meets Israel's Levy on peace.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian president meets Israel's Levy on peace.

text.p: Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak began talks on Tuesday in Egypt on the troubled Middle East peace process, witnesses said.

They said the Israeli minister, who arrived in Cairo on Tuesday and the Egyptian president, who frequently consults with the parties in the Middle East peace process, met in a Cairo government house called the al-Salam or "Peace" villa.

The latest crisis was touched off by last week's twin suicide bombing in Jerusalem's main Jewish market. The bombings killed 15 people including the two Arab attackers and plunged the already deadlocked Middle East process into further jeopardy.

Foreign Minister Amr Moussa had said on Monday that Levy's talks in Cairo would include the peace process and "the difficulties it faces, whether from the security angle or other measures that have obstructed the peace process and led to its freeze over the past few months".
